summary: Smith Micro Software filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose that it received a Nasdaq notice on June 23, 2026 confirming the company had regained compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement. The company had been non-compliant since June 2025 and was granted two 180-day cure periods. The closing price remained at or above $1.00 for ten consecutive business days through June 22, 2026. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or capital return is involved. This is a routine compliance disclosure with no special-situation implications. Watch for any future operational or strategic updates.
